text.div:
Annotation

Conclusion and Recommendations based on this report and previous findings known to us:
The patient shows hypoxemia, mild anemia, leukopenia, thrombocytopenia, and mild renal impairment (elevated creatinine). There is monocytosis and basophilia, with relative neutropenia and lymphopenia. Liver enzymes are low but not clinically significant. Findings may suggest bone marrow suppression or systemic illness with hypoxia and possible renal involvement; clinical correlation and further investigation are recommended.
